role.zh: 目标 rollup cell 的 type hash
role.en: type hash of the target rollup cell

role.zh: L1 所有者 lock hash（取消时需此 lock 的输入）
role.en: L1 owner lock hash (cancel needs an input under it)

role.zh: 存入后 L2 账户的 lock 脚本
role.en: lock script of the L2 account to credit

role.zh: since 值：超过后用户可取回
role.en: since value after which the user may cancel

cond.zh: 创建时不执行；规则在花费时与 state-validator 中检查
cond.en: not run at creation; checked when spent and by state-validator

boxes.body:
code cell (see deployments)
// needed by CKB to run the script

cond.zh: ≥ 32 字节且后续为合法 DepositLockArgs
输入中有 type hash = rollup_type_hash 的 cell → 通过（其余由 state-validator 检查：26）
cond.en: an input with type hash = rollup_type_hash → pass (the rest is state-validator: 26)

inputs.body:
Cell{
  since: {{same flags as cancel_timeout, value ≥ it}},
  capacity: D,
  lock: DEPOSIT_LOCK(rollup_type_hash ‖ args),
  type: any,
  data: any
}

boxes.body: owner lock signature (deposit-lock reads no witness)

cond.zh: GroupInput[0] 的 since flags = cancel_timeout flags，且值 ≥
cond.en: GroupInput[0] since has cancel_timeout’s flags and value ≥
an input with lock hash = owner_lock_hash

notes.zh: ⚠ 状态：官方已宣布 Godwoken 退役（2025-06-01 起，Nervos Talk “Sunset of Force Bridge and Godwoken”）；冻结期限延至 2026-01-01 23:59:59 UTC，之后网络冻结、桥前端下线，v0/v1 RPC 节点已关闭。本页仅作历史 / 审计参考。
notes.en: ⚠ Status: Godwoken was officially sunset (from 2025-06-01, Nervos Talk “Sunset of Force Bridge and Godwoken”); the freeze deadline was extended to 2026-01-01 23:59:59 UTC, after which the network froze, the bridge UI went offline and v0/v1 RPC nodes were shut down. This page is for historical / audit reference.
